body:
The unmatched-ingredient campaign needs guarded source application and bounded canonical publication for an explicitly reviewed owner plan. These operators bind published proposals, source cases, acceptance, actual producer bytes and complete owner inventories; they preserve native receipts and recoverable output evidence when applying an accepted batch.

Depends on #1158 at `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Current head is `e0a75a0c48ba539426b1f70623ea376c7b379ecf`. No maintained campaign owner has been applied. Ingredient changes and release products belong in a separate dependent PR after final plan and scientific acceptance. No merge is requested.

The ordinary fixes in `5288c882` and `e0a75a0c` address #1256 and #1257. Source application validates the captured literal Git index entries against the immutable accepted tree, binds later path/blob views to that state, and rechecks it before success. This detects observed index changes while permitting ordinary stat-cache refresh and valid installed staging; it does not claim a globally atomic OS transaction. Later historical verification remains supported. Publication retains the live accepted-HEAD guard through complete source-proof replay.

The publisher now distinguishes local registry rows by their full object IDs. Native primary identities and subject handles in one namespace both survive. Its explicit maintained alignment helper records a changed local identity as removal plus addition, with the old position mapped to null; it does not transfer historical identity provenance. The pinned historical receipt maker and receipts1–27 are unchanged. Complete native receipt, owner-chain and row replay checks remain required.

Other controls preserve inherited collision families (#1251), bounded rejected-record maintenance (#1252), literal Unicode Git paths (#1255), real source origins, exclusive output reservations and hold lineage. The separately reviewed #741 demotion removes every old Angustmycin slot without choosing A/C identity. Both owner paths must lack a prior native chain, and the actual closed relocation tuple must match the review.

**Application approval remains pending.** [#1259](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1259) records the remaining guarded suppression capability: four selected native events have genuine conditional scientific review, but the current publisher still refuses them. The new route must preserve34 historical sidecar rows, all27 receipt links, baseline, prior policy histories and original owner attribution. It must consume exact independent review and actual source/generation bindings; no allow flag or sidecar replacement. Only Corn Starch is currently in an old canonical token cell; the other three are new native event attributions. Congocidin and all other identity/role/export holds remain.

Addresses #1174, #1194, #1195, #1197, #1198, #1200, #1214, #1251, #1252, #1255, #1256 and #1257, plus the bounded #741 prerequisite. #1259 is filed before its implementation. Ancillary companion method finding #1258 is separate from these operator fixes.

Validation and review evidence:

- Source correction:546 passed, zero skips (382 source,144 then-current publisher,20 real native integrations). Separate independent review passed12 actual-native controls. Its private failed predecessor and the finding filed before correction remain preserved.
- Final registry-row correction:196 passed, zero skips (176 publisher,20 real native integrations), against the corrected source. Separate independent review found no new issue, verified all27 historical alignments, and exercised duplicate, coverage, ownership and local-retarget cases. Both fixes append regression coverage and retain all previous test bytes. Ruff, Black and Mypy passed. These are distinct runs, not one combined total.
- The bounded diagnostic contains3,756 rows:1,037 selected native rows plus2,719 byte-identical unselected canonical lines. Native replay is exact and all16 invariants report zero rejects. B4 coverage is partial:2,103 evaluated,1,558 outside prefix,94 missing transforms and one absent term. This diagnostic is not actual campaign publication or scientific release approval.
- Earlier exact7d4 worker review ran518 checks, including20 actual-native cases, and found the remaining source-index defect. Its session subsequently hit a platform risk flag before final native review assembly; that packet remains incomplete negative evidence. It is not approval of any successor.
- Historical16c `just qc` and full `just test` passed (5654 passed,116 existing skips).21061 QC passed, but its full suite was deliberately interrupted after145 partial passes when defects were confirmed. Neither substitutes for the final corrected head's required full QC, suite, CI and independent review, which remain pending while #1259 is implemented.
- Real integrations use isolated Claw `76c1ebeea3fc7f80bf1abe044688f298f390cfac` and immutable `eac469f1` with27 genuine receipts. Optional external roots may be absent in CI; actual local native execution is separately evidenced.

Root rehashed the source70-member author packet and43-member independent packet, and the publisher83-member author packet plus35-member independent packet, before ordinary commits and pushes. Source manifest `7f8b9f8c7183137b5fb090b2ea9a98555327a00e9922e62fb5e9f7e7791a798d`; publisher manifest `5fa828faa0f77ba405805461ad50bda899592852429c9e336ae8a4ee8ee77df9`. Durable commit receipts are under `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/source-coherence1256-commit-v2/` and `publisher-local-slots1257-commit-v1/`.

The reviewed evidence selections now have1,073 original files plus4descriptors copied under `reports/unmatched_campaign_operators_1174_20261108/`, still uncommitted. Their final additions, actual whole-diff review and ordinary archive commit remain pending. Historical manifests, failed probes and original review identities are retained with their original scope; an archive is not a new scientific vote. No workflow, threshold, protected evidence gate or validator pin is changed by these fixes.
